27	class BlobBlockHashes(Sequence[BlockHash]):
28	    """Lazy view over a flat buffer of fixed-size block hashes to avoid the overhead
29	    of materializing all hashes upfront.
30	    """
31	
32	    def __init__(self, blob: memoryview, hash_len: int):
33	        self._blob = blob
34	        self._hash_len = hash_len
35	        self._n = len(blob) // hash_len if hash_len else 0
36	
37	    def __len__(self) -> int:
38	        return self._n
39	
40	    def __getitem__(self, idx):
41	        if isinstance(idx, slice):
42	            return [self[i] for i in range(*idx.indices(self._n))]
43	        if idx < 0:
44	            idx += self._n
45	        if not 0 <= idx < self._n:
46	            raise IndexError(idx)
47	        off = idx * self._hash_len
48	        return BlockHash(self._blob[off : off + self._hash_len])

51	class _CompactChunkHashList(BlockHashListWithBlockSize):
52	    """View that keys each ``block_size`` chunk by the last constituent
53	    ``hash_block_size`` hash instead of concatenating all of them.
54	
55	    The engine chains block hashes (each hash folds in the previous one), so the
56	    final sub-block hash of a chunk already uniquely identifies the whole chunk
57	    and its prefix. Using it keeps a Mooncake key at a single hash digest
58	    regardless of the ``block_size`` / ``hash_block_size`` ratio, instead of
59	    growing the key linearly with it (e.g. 64x for ``block_size=256``,
60	    ``hash_block_size=4``).
61	    """
62	
63	    def __init__(
64	        self,
65	        block_hashes: Sequence[BlockHash],
66	        hash_block_size: int,
67	        target_block_size: int,
68	    ):
69	        # Accept any indexable sequence (e.g. the lazy ``BlobBlockHashes``), not
70	        # just ``list``; the base only indexes/sizes it.
71	        assert target_block_size % hash_block_size == 0
72	        self.block_hashes = block_hashes  # type: ignore[assignment]
73	        self.scale_factor = target_block_size // hash_block_size
74	
75	    def _get_value_at(self, idx: int) -> BlockHash:
76	        return self.block_hashes[idx * self.scale_factor + self.scale_factor - 1]
77

79	def chunk_hashes_for_block_size(
80	    block_hashes: Sequence[BlockHash],
81	    hash_block_size: int,
82	    block_size: int,
83	) -> Sequence[BlockHash]:
84	    """Map ``hash_block_size``-granular block hashes to one compact hash per
85	    ``block_size`` chunk (the chunk's last sub-hash). Returns ``block_hashes``
86	    unchanged when the two sizes are equal.
87	    """
88	    if block_size == hash_block_size:
89	        return block_hashes
90	    # Structurally a Sequence[BlockHash] (indexable + sized); the base class
91	    # just isn't declared as one.
92	    return cast(
93	        "Sequence[BlockHash]",
94	        _CompactChunkHashList(block_hashes, hash_block_size, block_size),
95	    )
